# Wipro's Water Management Targets

**Revised Targets from FY26 onwards** [Wipro, p.74]:
- Reduce the absolute consumption of freshwater year-on-year by 3% in all operationally-controlled facilities
- Maintain Zero Liquid Discharge of untreated wastewater across all owned facilities
- Continue to treat 100% of all used water as per safe standards
- Increase the utilization of treated water to constitute 45% of total water use by 2030

**Additional Context:**
Wipro's water management strategy is guided by their Water Policy and focuses on water efficiency and responsible management of water, including conservation, reuse of treated water, and rainwater harvesting [Wipro, p.73-74]. Progress on water targets is reviewed quarterly by the Wipro Board [Wipro, p.73].

# HCLTech's Water Usage Reduction

HCLTech has reduced water usage through several key initiatives [HCLTech, p.57]:

**Technical Interventions:**
- Water recycling plants
- Reusing AHU condensate and rainwater
- Water-efficient measures including water aerators in all wash basin taps
- Automated irrigation systems with sprinkler and drip irrigation

**Wastewater Treatment:**
- Sewage Treatment Plants (STP) that treat wastewater, which is then repurposed for flushing in washrooms and watering plants [HCLTech, p.57]
- Advanced MBR/MBBR treatment combinations

**Community Projects:**
- Rainwater harvesting and community water management projects [HCLTech, p.57]

**Results:**
Since 2020, HCLTech has achieved a **40% reduction in water usage in India**, where the majority of their operations are based [HCLTech, p.3]. Additionally, their community initiatives replenished 32 times more water than they consumed throughout the year [HCLTech, p.3].

The company has set targets of 5% year-on-year water consumption reduction for all owned facilities and fixed recycled water utilization at 45% for all owned facilities [HCLTech, p.57].
